name: cargo-nextest
why: Test runner used by CI (`cargo nextest run --workspace`). Runs each test in its own process, which matters here because agent-profile tests spawn the binary and the fake-agent fixture and set per-process environment. Does NOT run doctests — pair with `cargo test --doc`.
gates: `just check`; CI Test job on ubuntu, macos, windows

name: just
why: Task runner and the single entry point for the local gate. `just check` = fmt-check + clippy + typos + test. Configured by the root justfile.
gates: everything — local gate, pre-push hook and CI all route through the recipes it defines

name: lefthook
why: Git hooks. pre-push runs `just fmt-check`, `just clippy` and `just typos` in parallel; there is no pre-commit hook, so commits stay fast. Routing through just keeps the hook and CI from drifting apart. Configured by lefthook.yml; needs `lefthook install` once per clone.
config: `lefthook.yml` (pre-push: fmt-check, clippy, typos in parallel; no pre-commit)

name: cargo-deny
why: Advisory, licence, ban and source auditing across the dependency graph. Configured by deny.toml, which pins the allow-listed licences, bans openssl-sys (V3 spec §36: no hidden network activity) and lists the per-platform target triples.
config: `deny.toml` (licence allow-list, `openssl-sys` ban per V3 §36, 7 target triples)

name: typos
why: Spell-checks source and prose; runs as its own CI job and in `just check`. Configured by _typos.toml, which excludes the delivered V3 spec.

name: bacon
why: Background check/clippy/test watcher during development (`just watch`). Configured by bacon.toml; default job is check-all.

name: cargo-mutants
why: Mutation testing (`just mutants`) for the invariant-heavy library: profile-name validation, resolution precedence, config atomicity. .gitignore already excludes mutants.out*.

name: actionlint
why: Lints the GitHub Actions workflows. Runs the shell in each `run:` step through shellcheck when shellcheck is on PATH; without it that check is silently skipped (visible only with `actionlint -verbose`).

name: shellcheck
why: Lets actionlint check the shell inside workflow `run:` steps; actionlint disables that rule when shellcheck is not on PATH.

name: Sandboxie-Plus
why: The Windows sandbox for measuring real coding agents (CONTRIBUTING.md "Measuring agent behaviour"): adapter evidence is refreshed only inside a disposable box, never by installing agents on the host. Windows only; Linux and macOS contributors use the Podman/Bubblewrap or Tart/OrbStack recipes in CONTRIBUTING.md, and this check has no platform guard, so it lists Sandboxie-Plus as missing there.
gates: manual — CONTRIBUTING.md "Measuring agent behaviour" (Windows adapter-evidence refresh)

name: podman
why: The container engine `sandbox/run.sh` runs the probe harness in, and the one CI uses (`AGENT_PROFILE_SANDBOX_ENGINE: podman` in both sandbox.yml jobs). Docker is an accepted fallback and run.sh selects it automatically when podman is absent, but the two are NOT equivalent for this repo: run.sh:85-87 sets `--userns=keep-id:uid=1000,gid=1000` ONLY under podman, so anything about uid mapping across the /out bind mount is unreproducible under Docker. That matters for the two-user privilege boundary, where a second uid writing the mount is the specific hazard. On Windows podman needs its own VM (`podman machine`), which is still not the Linux runner CI uses — so prefer dispatching the Actions Sandbox workflow for uid-mapping questions, and install podman locally when you would otherwise be iterating by re-pushing to CI.
gates: on demand; `.github/workflows/sandbox.yml` runs the same on a GitHub runner with **podman** (probes by hand; `test` on PRs that change the harness)

name: rustup / rustc / cargo
why: Installs and manages the Rust toolchain pinned by rust-toolchain.toml (stable, with rustfmt + clippy); every other tool here builds or runs through it.

name: rustfmt
why: Formats Rust source. Ships as a rustup component; enforced in the local gate, the pre-push hook and CI.

name: clippy
why: Lints Rust source with warnings promoted to errors. Ships as a rustup component; enforced in the local gate, the pre-push hook and CI.

name: cargo-binstall
why: Installs the other cargo-based tools here (cargo-nextest, just, lefthook, cargo-deny, typos-cli, bacon, cargo-mutants) from prebuilt binaries instead of compiling each from source.
